notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Welp, since the day I announced my delay, a lot of progress has been made. A lot of polishing has been made and a lot of balancing as well. There's even a fast travel! Check that out!

This past two weeks has been hectic for me that I forgot to post a new demo for the indie fest. So, I've uploaded a new polished demo for you guys to take a look and play! Hopefully I'm not too late. I'll also upload a broadcast sometime soon this week as well for those of you that just want to quickly glance at the game and check out how it is. I'll talk about the game development in my broadcast.

As for the game update and how it's going. I would say it's 95% complete. I just need to wait on a bit more art, make a bit more music, and have a few more testers to play the final version of the game one last time. Very very very close to being done. In my next post, I'll give you a confirm release date of when Harvest Island can be played. It really will be released this year!

Here's the list of new things:
-Game scale (You can now zoom into the game 2x since people had a hard time seeing the game)
-Text box animated to come from sides
-Clear petting Objectives (This reduces confusion and helps balance the game when you feed, tend to the animals, and pet them)
-UI Art implemented
-Animals have Favorite foods (I'll let you figure the secret out :))
-New Heart Emoji
- New fish animation
-New coconut animation
- New bugs animation
- New Well watering Animation
- New cotton animation
- New apple tree animation
- Replaced a few old object arts (Like logs, twigs, mussels, apples)
-Refined part of the story's writing so that it doesn't feel repetitive.
- New Character Portraits (Lot's of new expressions added)
- Fast Travel added (There's an entire new world in that fast travel!)
- Balanced food consumption and energy consumption for "Tutorial" part.
- Extended the demo just a little bit more so that the game has a resolution and finishes the game's "Tutorial" and premise.
-Added 3 children's story books (Read it in the father's room once you journey along the game a bit)
-New Translations added (But this is a bit incomplete since I'm still working on this.)
-Added Nap Feature

There's probably a lot more which I can't remember from the top of my head since I'm just working purely in getting the final game released vs keeping the game updated to you guys. There's a lot of changes and I know you'll like them.

notes.title: The Game's Release Date
notes.notes:
The steam festival is coming up in 1 month and I'll be doing a stream of my game through this page! I've been on the steam festival before but it still hasn't gotten the recognition this game deserves so I'm hoping things will change since a lot has changed from the last years I've participated. Been working on this game for 4 years so of course things changed a lot. I've even added a bit new mechanics to the game to help keep the game fun like changing the weather! I did a dev log about it in a humorous way to help with the attention on youtube. This'll tell the algorithm that my content is good. Hopefully...
[previewyoutube=X94thlET9vU;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyways, the game is very close to competition and I just need a few more months to release it. I'll give an exact release date once my game enters 95% completion since currently right now it's at around 70-75% done. Maybe 80%. I just need to add a bit more music, finish programming the story, and bug test the game. Not a lot to do in terms of list, but a lot of work since it requires tons of hours to implement. It's safe to say that I can finish this game early next year. 

I've also been updating the demo a lot and making sure that the gameplay is smooth and fun to play with lots of objects that isn't fetch quest. A lot of the time to make this game comes from design, so I hope you guys enjoy what I created when the game gets released. I can say that this farming game is very different from the farming games other indie devs make. It just branches off from the traditional design of the other farming games. Hopefully you guys will like it and I'm very excited for you guys to play it! Anyways, look forward to the stream as I'll play beyond what the demo restricts you to play. I'll show you guys the buildings, fishing, and even a little bit more of the story!

notes.title: Potato farming in Indie Game Sucks
notes.notes:
Hi,

It's been a while but I have good news! I'm seriously starting a youtube channel to help promote Harvest Island more. This is a good thing for you because I'll be making Harvest Island Content! So, some of these content will reveal new areas in Harvest Island, but it's purely comical. Sometimes I'll post developer progress but most of the time, I just want to make you laugh. It's something I can do while developing Harvest Island at the same time since I know you guys have been waiting for this game for a long time. If you followed me in the super early stages, that's 2 years!

As you may have read the title, potato farming in indie game sucks. Not really haha. It's the title of my youtube video that I'm showing you!

[previewyoutube=YNbH-IhzLkA;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you enjoyed that video! And I really encourage you to follow me on youtube. Like and subscribe too! I've got a stockpile of videos that'll last me for two months and I'll continue to do this until I release my game. I'll be uploading frequently.

As for the game Harvest island. I know the biggest question is when will it be finished? Well, I have the entire game development road map planned out and I have a set date when I want to finish this game. This is pretty much what I have left to do to finish the game.

This is literally taken out of my notes from the big canvas I have written... But I'll explain more after you take a quick glance at it. (The sloppy writing is from me using a mouse lol)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39141715/6b569d2a7ed22969f0af6c95b3aaf6ea0908e01c.png[/img]

The main art which is all of the environmental art is 85-90% done.
The illustration is probably 20% done. This isn't a big deal since I have someone else working on these. So it shouldn't affect the release of the game.
Water tides is a code for me to say that, replace all the water in the game and be sure to add low tides and high tides. Pretty much a rework of the beaches in Harvest Island. This is maybe 10% finished. I still have to program a few things before the tides are final.
And then there's the secret animal map. That's pretty much is a secret :) But this is 0% done. If people have been following my dev log on my website, wild animals are really important.

Next we have Eventing. This just means to me that I have to create cutscenes for the game. Particularly the main story. And I'm talking about the ending of my game. So, you can say that the entire game's cutscenes is about 50% complete. The other 50% is the game's end game. This also implies other background programing I have to do like achievements, quests, and NPC Dialogue.

Story is 90% finished. All I have to do is write the game's lore. Which will take a while. And also write the the game's ending which is already planned out. I can't finish this without finishing the art so this will take a while for me to even start writing the game's ending. Plus there's the illustrations I have to wait on as well.

Testing. This is pretty much 0%. I have tested the game while I was developing it. So if things broke, I would fix it quickly, but small bugs that I wouldn't even think of testing would take some time for me to find them. Plus I'm going to find friends and have them play the game blindly. You can consider testing as polishing phase. Which will take a huge amount of time from me because I would be playing the game beginning to end like 100x to find bugs with different style playthroughs. And the game is pretty long and kinda open world. Would you even consider stardew valley open world? Well, you can say my game has the freedom to explore.

Easter egg island. That's just code for me to design the game's easter eggs. Yeah, it's pretty much self explanatory. If you guys played the beta, I'm sure you found game references. This island is pretty much answering those references. This is at 0% but I already have planned everything out for this.

And finally music. I'll be writing a lot of music. The game's music is probably 40%-50% done. Writing music is pretty quick for me unless I have to write a 5 min orchestral piece. We will see how my testers say about my music. If it's bad, I'm upping the level of music. If it's good, You can expect the game to release sooner. Also, I'm thinking about adding a singer which I already have lined up.

And that's pretty much everything currently with Harvest Island. So when will the game get released? I'm too afraid to give you the date because this is a lot of work, but I made deadlines for myself to finish. (Hopefully in a understandable time frame that doesn't kill me) This lets you peek into how soon Harvest Island will be finished and I hope that this is enough to keep you waiting.

And be sure to subscribe on youtube if you haven't yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39141715/22b1a4c2a4147bd3cf2bdcbe70bd47d409894201.png[/img]

notes.title: Harvest Island Rollback
notes.notes:
I have good news and I have bad news. Let's start with the bad news. I have to revert Harvest Island before the big demo version update. Which was released a few months ago. Which means, you'll be playing Harvest Island Beginnings from when I first initially designed the game without the community feedback. Why? Because that version had all the translations to my game. I cannot translate the new demo version because I do not have the time or budget for it, currently, and because the game won't be released until another while. And I don't want to prevent international players to not enjoy Harvest Island to some degree. Another reason is that the new version is undergoing a lot of changes, again. For the better! So, if I keep updating the demo, it'll be extremely confusing to existing players to understand the story. There's just too many revisions I have gone through in the background.

Let's jump to the good news. The game is still in development. The game still has the budget and will still have all the translations being done. The game is halfway done with a lot of the mechanics in place. And the best news yet, I am trying to aim the game's release date by early next year. 2022. Wait...that might be a bad thing since the game is being delayed. But I promise you, you won't regret it. A rushed game is a bad game.

Sorry for the rollback and I believe there are youtube videos, well, at least one that I saw, that captures the new game demo!

This is for the greater good of the game! I promise you! This helps with marketing and international awareness. Which this game badly needs.

notes.title: Lucky 10% Beta Access Or Join Discord
notes.notes:
Harvest Island has a lot of work before it gets released. There's so much to do and the only person working on it all is the developer: Me. Especially marketing. So, I am opening a closed beta demo until Feb 15th to play the game! With whatever I have worked on will be playable on Jan 31st. It's not perfect, but it's more than enough to enjoy the game. A lot more than the demo. Like 2-4+ hours more. And that's not even half the planned content I have in store for Harvest Island. There will be missing content, possible bugs, and a cliff hanger. So please join [url=https://discord.gg/RXpX4SQvTm]Discord[/url] in order to report them!

Let's get back to the topic of the lucky 10% beta access. Yeah, only 10% of you will be able to play Harvest Island Beta. Starting now until Jan 31st, steam will track the amount of signups and I'll only allow 10% to play the game. So that's two weeks you have to click on the "request access" and wait until I open the game on Jan 31st.

But what if I'm not lucky? I still want to play. Do I have to watch it on youtube? That sucks...

Fret not, I'm a kind developer. Everyday, 25 lucky winners who joins [url=https://discord.gg/RXpX4SQvTm]Discord[/url] and participates in the giveaway will have a chance to play Harvest Island! That's 350 keys I'm giving away just to join discord. (The discord is small, there's a high chance you will win - unless this goes viral - then pray, and I mean pray really hard that you'll get a key)

Yeah...I'm not so lucky in life. I'm all about hard work.

No problem. To all the twitch streamers, youtubers, and content creators if you have more than 5,000 subscribers to your channel, you'll be able to play Harvest Island. But there are conditions. You have to prove that you own that account. Send me a message through your social media to my accounts. [url=https://yobobgames.com/contact/]Email[/url] works, [url=https://twitter.com/YobobGames]twitter[/url] DM works, [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPqVt0Y743bbi0I29uGq20Q]Youtube[/url] DM works. Even [url=https://www.instagram.com/yobobgames/]Instagram[/url]! I did say content creators. (Must be game related)

For every 10,000 subscribers that you have, You'll receive 1 extra beta demo key to do a giveaway on your own channel! If you have 10,000 subscribers, you get 1 beta demo key + a key to yourself. 20,000 subscribers, 2 beta demo keys + one to yourself. And the math goes on...

Alright, that's a lot to take in. So...let the two week giveaway commence!
